notes.title: An Update on Projekt Z's Release
notes.content: [p]Hello Survivors,[/p][p]Your feedback and excitement have inspired us to think big with Projekt Z.[/p][p]We’re expanding the scope, exploring new features, and raising the quality bar for every part of the experience. To make that happen, we’re shifting our launch to 2026.[/p][p]This extra time will let us deliver the game we’ve always envisioned, and the one you deserve. We know delays aren’t fun, but we truly believe the wait will be worth it.[/p][p]In the meantime, there’s a lot to look forward to:[/p][list][*][p]We’ll be at Gamescom this year at an off-site event, showing to media and creators the very first chapter of Projekt Z.[/p][/*][*][p]Playtests are already underway, with more slots opening soon (under NDA for now).[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for sticking with us through this journey. Your support means everything, and we can’t wait to share more in the months ahead.[/p]

notes.title: Projekt Z: Beyond Order | Blogpost #5
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Survivors![/h2]

Welcome back to our latest devblog! We apologize for the radio silence while we've been hard at work polishing the combat and crafting immersive, atmospheric environments that will bring Projekt Z to life when you finally step into the world. We know you're eagerly awaiting more details on launch, which we'll share in a big update soon. 

In the meantime, we’re excited to give a look into some of what we've been working on, including new UI, Hideout changes and more. 

[h3]First Look at New UI[/h3]
We've completely revamped the UI system and we're happy with the progress we've made!

[b]Workbench (Modify Weapon)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/21023a762767924c706307b6d6296ceec6c305fc.png[/img]

[b]Workbench (Repair Weapon)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/abdaac8c2299c406ae30f138bf552579b839922b.png[/img]

[h3]Shooting Range[/h3]
In the Hideout we've added a shooting range where you can test your newly built weapons. Doesn't feel quite right or work how you want it to? Head back to the workbench after a few rounds and make the necessary changes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/8e513822c9c957b418402990b16fca72a67c274b.gif[/img]

[h3]Character Intro Cutscenes[/h3]
Each of our four characters now has their own unique cutscene! When you select your character, you'll get taken to a specific cutscene to learn about the character's backstory. Start new games to learn about all our survivors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/28ee190f65b0b95bc2cf50e4c9ce73180c5fd525.gif[/img]

[h3]Mission Interaction[/h3]
We've worked hard to design almost every mission interaction to now have an animation! We believe this will yield a more immersive playing experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/1da5eb91963fd97baaf8f7f76fc4b0ea0752a5c4.gif[/img]

[h3]Lighting Rework[/h3]
Another major polishing change is we've reworked our lighting to provide a much crisper environment. Check out the drastic changes in this before and after clip.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/4688c9dfd20edde5cc28b75da1470a6eec6ad162.gif[/img]

[h3]Hideout Design Changes[/h3]
We've done a major overhaul to the Hideout by adding new areas such as the shooting range, and making a better Feng Shui in the shelter. Our new lighting changes and redesign make every part of the Hideout feel unique. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/ca4fb457c54387412ba718c07f0041d012e165e7.gif[/img]

If you haven't already, be sure to join our Discord server to be a part of the development journey. We value your input and often share exclusive work-in-progress content and surveys to gather your early feedback.

Stay tuned for more updates as we continue to fine-tune and polish Projekt Z: Beyond Order into the ultimate coop experience. Until then, stay vigilant, stay alive, and never stop fighting. The fate of humanity rests in your hands.

notes.title: Projekt Z: Beyond Order | Blogpost #4
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Survivors![/h2]

Welcome back to our latest devblog! We’re excited to share some big updates as we continue to shape the world of Projekt Z. This time, we’re introducing new weapons to give you even more ways to take on the undead. Prepare to unleash the versatile AS44 assault rifle, dominate with the rapid-fire MG42, and get up close and personal with our first melee weapon, the brutal Table Leg.

We’ve also been listening to your feedback and are adding a fresh Grunt variant to balance out the number of Officers on the island, creating more variety in your encounters. Plus, we’re unveiling the Radioactive Zombie (Jumper)—a special enemy that will keep you on your toes with a whole new level of challenge.

And behind the scenes, our level design team is hard at work crafting immersive, atmospheric environments that will bring Projekt Z to life when you finally step into the world. Stay tuned as we continue to push forward—there’s much more to come!

By the way, here's our latest trailer, which aired during the Indie Horror Showcase in October.

[previewyoutube=ZeJflSvZYfE;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/763310/Projekt_Z_Beyond_Order

[h3]Weapon Update[/h3]

In our last update, we introduced three new weapons: the Kar98, the M1897 shotgun, and the versatile Gustloff 206, each adding fresh tactical options for different play styles. This time, we’re excited to reveal even more firepower that’s sure to shake things up on the island!

First, meet the AS44, a reliable assault rifle with impressive versatility. It’s designed to handle both close-quarters combat and mid-range engagements, giving you the flexibility to adapt on the fly and keep enemies at a distance or take them head-on.

Next, the MG42—a rapid-fire machine gun with a reputation for its sheer power and high rate of fire. This weapon is perfect for players who want to lay down suppressing fire and control choke points. Mastering the MG42 will allow you to hold your ground and turn the tide of any engagement.

And for players looking to get up close and personal, we’re also introducing our very first melee weapon! With this new addition, you’ll have the opportunity to engage zombies at close range in an entirely new way, making stealthy approaches and tactical ambushes more viable than ever.

With these powerful new weapons, your options in combat are expanding like never before. We can’t wait to see how you’ll wield the AS44, MG42, and the melee weapon in your strategy!

[list]
[*] [b]AS-44[/b]
The AS-44 (Avtomat Sudayeva, Russian: Автома́т Суда́ева, АС-44) is a series of prototype Soviet assault rifles designed and developed by Alexey Sudayev in 1944—1945, they were produced in limited numbers and tested in 1944—1945, but its development ended in 1946 due to the death of its designer. 
(Source: Wikipedia)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/94ea3c6f0e140df51dcd4275997182bd52bbcec7.gif[/img]

[*] [b]MG42[/b]
The MG 42 (shortened from German: Maschinengewehr 42, or "machine gun 42") is a German recoil-operated air-cooled general-purpose machine gun used extensively by the Wehrmacht and the Waffen-SS during the second half of World War II. Entering production in 1942, it was intended to supplement and replace the earlier MG 34, which was more expensive and took much longer to produce, but both weapons were produced until the end of World War II. 
(Source: Wikipedia)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/77bd4d06e291a8d9178205b593c4a628be7ecb8f.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/ffdbfc034a9cfe75990ac7efbd75f84df8d814c1.gif[/img]
(Yes, it can overheat!)

[*] [b]Tableleg[/b]
Introducing the Table Leg, our first melee weapon! This rugged, improvised weapon is perfect for close-quarters zombie takedowns, adding a brutal, hands-on approach to your survival arsenal.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/79ecdc580e10e108a4f65e8496a4794301c5a56c.gif[/img]
[/list]

[h3]Zombie Update[/h3]

Following our recent trailers, we received a lot of feedback about our Grunt zombies—specifically, that there are just too many Officers roaming around. We couldn’t agree more! So, we jumped right into action and created a new variant of the Grunt to balance things out.

Along with introducing this fresh take on the Grunt, we're excited to unveil something even more unique: one of our special zombies, the Radioactive Zombie, also known as the Jumper. This distinctive enemy will add a whole new level of challenge and excitement to your encounters.

[list]
[*] [b]More Zombie Grunts[/b]
This Devlog introduces a new variant of the Grunt zombie, designed to bring more diversity to the island and balance the number of Officers.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/a2775513a4eeb7e572e9d9faa60d93c52f1f18ef.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Radioactive Zombie (Jumper)[/b]
The Radioactive Zombie, also known as the Jumper, is one of the most dangerous enemies you’ll face. Highly agile and unpredictable, this zombie’s intense radioactivity has given it a unique ability to teleport short distances, allowing it to close in or escape in an instant. With its rapid movement and disorienting attack style, every encounter with the Jumper will demand quick reflexes and a well-planned strategy to survive.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/ff0c2904ddcbf667571578bc4870dd575a336e0b.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/bbde47f8672466328abf0be7cf7e8398a686479c.gif[/img]

[h3]Mission Update[/h3]

Our level design team has been working tirelessly to bring the world of Projekt Z to life. With countless hours dedicated to crafting immersive environments, we're excited to share some of their incredible progress. From the intricate details of the landscapes to the atmospheric lighting that sets the mood, every aspect has been meticulously designed to enhance your gameplay experience. Check out the screenshots below for a sneak peek at the stunning levels our team has created!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/06cf60c012a245cc1f088fb3e3190a1e8f3ce65d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/737fa7b809622f12ec99cfe27fdf9d96235b56b5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/20474714d11f02fbdf98d74aa2c3747f7034188e.png[/img]

[h3]Unveiling the Latest: Inside Our Newest Devlog - Projekt Z: Beyond Order Update[/h3]
[previewyoutube=yQpMX3ewC0g;full][/previewyoutube]
If you haven't already, be sure to join our Discord server to be a part of the development journey. We value your input and often share exclusive work-in-progress content and surveys to gather your early feedback.

Stay tuned for more updates as we continue to fine-tune and polish Projekt Z: Beyond Order into the ultimate coop experience. Until then, stay vigilant, stay alive, and never stop fighting. The fate of humanity rests in your hands.

notes.title: Projekt Z: Beyond Order | Blogpost #3
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Survivors![/h2]

Welcome back to our Development Blog! In this update, we'll dive into the exciting new weapons we've added, give you a sneak peek at the two last characters, and show you some awesome level design updates.

Let's get started!

[previewyoutube=d7Mi2BbZFjs;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/763310/Projekt_Z_Beyond_Order

[h3]Weapon Update[/h3]

In our last update, we introduced you to the Kar98, M1897, and Gustloff206. At that time, these weapons were still in development and not yet available in the game. Now, we're thrilled to announce that these weapons are fully operational. We're excited to show you their performance in action and how they can enhance your gameplay experience!
[list]
[*] [b]Prototype Gustloff Model 206[/b]
This is a rare example of a WWII German Prototype sheet metal semi-automatic rifle that was manufactured by Gustloff-Werke in Weimar. This design closely follows various other late war German designed rifles and pistols that were manufactured using sheet metal stampings and minimal machined parts.
(Source: Rockislandauction)
[previewyoutube=BFwrUqy68y8;full][/previewyoutube]

[*][b]M1897[/b]
The M1897, also known as the Model 97, M97, Riot Gun, or Trench Gun, is a pump-action shotgun with an external hammer and tube magazine manufactured by the Winchester Repeating Arms Company. (Source: Wikipedia)
[previewyoutube=nK9vEKHxAn4;full][/previewyoutube]

[*][b]Kar98[/b]
The Karabiner 98 kurz, often abbreviated Karabiner 98k, Kar98k or K98k and also sometimes incorrectly referred to as a K98, is a bolt-action rifle chambered for the 7.92×57mm Mauser cartridge. It was adopted on 21 June 1935 as the standard service rifle by the German Wehrmacht. 
(Source: Wikipedia)
[previewyoutube=I6PrIGmXmwo;full][/previewyoutube]
[/list]
[h3]Character Abilities Sneak Peek[/h3]

In the last development blog, we also introduced you to two of our characters and their unique abilities. Now, we're excited to unveil the final two members of our roster: Hans and Curtis. Each character brings their own distinct background and specialized skills to the table, adding depth and diversity to your gameplay experience. In this blog post, we’ll dive into the fascinating histories of Hans and Curtis, exploring what drives them and how their abilities can be utilized to survive the challenges ahead. Get ready to meet Hans, the meticulous scientist with his devastating flamethrower, and Curtis, the fearless ace pilot with his explosive flaregun traps.

[b]Hans Bergmann[/b]

Hans Bergmann hails from the serene spa town of Baden Baden, born into a family of aristocrats loyal to Emperor Wilhelm II. After the Great War and the Spanish Flu claimed his mother, Hans' father, Otto, became distant and cold. Seeking approval, Hans excelled at boarding school and piano but was pushed towards science to align with Germany's industrial rise.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/ae72f7842e9e152b26f11915f11d94972de4cbc6.jpg[/img]

[u]Flamethrower X[/u]
[list]
[*] This Ability is essential for crowd control and survival against the zombie hordes. With it, Hans can unleash a torrent of flames, incinerating zombies in its path. Its range and damage make it perfect for clearing tight spaces and holding off large groups of enemies. The intense heat not only burns zombies but also causes panic and disarray among them, giving Hans a strategic advantage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/1a599e57b45f589cc7044f300f0af7ba2ced638a.gif[/img]
[/list]

[b]Curtis Ashford[/b]

Curtis Ashford was born into a prestigious military family with deep ties to the United States Navy. His father, Captain Ashford, had high hopes for Curtis to follow in his footsteps. However, Curtis' passion for aviation led him to become a pilot, inspired by the strength and agility of the Golden Eagle. Curtis excelled at the Naval Academy and quickly proved his skills in the air, becoming an ace pilot during World War II.

Assigned to the 6th Fleet, Curtis flew Republic P-47 Thunderbolts and gained a fearsome reputation over Malta, earning over 15 confirmed kills. His aircraft, marked with a flaming skull, became a symbol of fear for enemy forces. Despite a tragic mission where he was the sole survivor, Curtis continued to serve with distinction throughout the war, flying P-51 Mustangs and participating in critical missions over Nazi Germany.

After the war, Curtis rose to the rank of Lieutenant Commander and was tasked with leading a top-secret mission to a hidden island in the southern ocean, where Nazi scientists conducted secret research. On this mission, Curtis utilizes his unique ability: the Flaregun X12 Prototype.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/eebc8745d6569e12f190108d11d9f79561165e6f.jpg[/img]

[u]X12 Prototype[/u]

[list]
[*] The X12 Prototype is Curtis' ability, allowing him to set explosive traps. These traps detonate automatically when an enemy gets too close, providing strategic control over the battlefield. The X12 can be used to create choke points, ambushes, and defensive perimeters, making Curtis a versatile and tactical asset in any combat scenario.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/be7c04ebb4aef93526db08c7b4cd32765aab3409.gif[/img]
[/list]

[h3]Mission Updates[/h3]

Our level design team has been working tirelessly to bring the world of Projekt Z to life. With countless hours dedicated to crafting immersive environments, we're excited to share some of their incredible progress. From the intricate details of the landscapes to the atmospheric lighting that sets the mood, every aspect has been meticulously designed to enhance your gameplay experience. Check out the screenshots below for a sneak peek at the stunning levels our team has created!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/a930e2a177826ba74fdcc9e9c0e8892f92f57e51.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/96ef88a7f8e219d4060ccfc32f1315a1bb923e89.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/f6a25dab61b3882348e85407dca24b5796787ba8.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Projekt Z: Beyond Order | Blogpost #2
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Survivors![/h2]

We're excited to share our latest development blog post with you! In today's update, we unveil revamped graphics, introduce new weaponry, delve into Alina and Gustav's primary abilities, and offer an exclusive sneak peek at the Free-Roam mode.

[previewyoutube=d7Mi2BbZFjs;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/763310/Projekt_Z_Beyond_Order

[h3]Revamped Graphics[/h3]

We're constantly striving to elevate the visual prowess of Projekt Z: Beyond Order. Despite the misconception that Unity games lack visual appeal, we're determined to showcase that it's not about the engine but rather the expertise of those wielding it. Today, we're excited to unveil some screenshots highlighting the lighting and rendering enhancements we've implemented.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/e9f3024501f45cab6828e298accfb16519eac51c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/a9ce927ce7b26c361d7ab726f94378c49f8380f2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/6faaa18473798b1f079c533de1b57c64b1137dd7.png[/img]

[h3]New Weapons[/h3]

Our dedicated weapon and animation department has been hard at work, making substantial progress in broadening our array of weaponry. Through meticulous attention to detail and creative ingenuity, they've been diligently crafting new additions to enhance your gaming experience. Today, we're delighted to provide you with an exclusive sneak peek into the exciting weapons they're currently bringing to life.
[list]
[*] [b]Prototype Gustloff Model 206[/b]
This is a rare example of a WWII German Prototype sheet metal semi-automatic rifle that was manufactured by Gustloff-Werke in Weimar. This design closely follows the various other late war German designed rifles and pistols that were manufactured using sheet metal stampings and minimal machined parts.
(Source: Rockislandauction)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/a7bda4ea553164ae62d429d157bfed77e2cbc2b9.jpg[/img]

[*][b]M1897[/b]
The M1897, also known as the Model 97, M97, Riot Gun, or Trench Gun, is a pump-action shotgun with an external hammer and tube magazine manufactured by the Winchester Repeating Arms Company. (Source: Wikipedia)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/9beb70b6dd4ef273b8f743fdf2ca5ba5c4c3e391.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/0aa3dd0f11c22ae78d7378b3a2a554bcfd6777fe.gif[/img]

[*][b]Kar98[/b]
The Karabiner 98 kurz, often abbreviated Karabiner 98k, Kar98k or K98k and also sometimes incorrectly referred to as a K98, is a bolt-action rifle chambered for the 7.92×57mm Mauser cartridge. It was adopted on 21 June 1935 as the standard service rifle by the German Wehrmacht. 
(Source: Wikipedia)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/917607f6e6c90f79d40cd86a697546bbe236a2df.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/5586f82240006906a7c652303b0d273fd41d7cf1.gif[/img]
[/list]
[h3]Free-Roam Sneak Peek[/h3]

Introducing Free-Roam mode, a dynamic segment of the game where players can scavenge for valuable resources and items outside of specific story missions. It's our Extraction Game Mode, but in a cooperative-only setting, offering unparalleled freedom and camaraderie. Upon completing a Story Mission, almost every map becomes accessible in this mode.

[b]Enter The Free-Roam[/b]
Here's how it works: Upon entering a Free-Roam Mission, players are given a generous 15-minute window to explore and gather loot. But beware, if the timer runs out, all loot brought into the mission is forfeited, marking a lost opportunity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/71ccb5bda9d8738b8d8e3c74752f58548a654673.gif[/img]

[b]Extract[/b]
To successfully extract, players must reach out via radio to the "Hideout" to get a pickup zone assigned to them, accompanied by yet another timer. Failure to reach the designated pickup point in time results in losing all accumulated loot. Upon arrival, players must signal their readiness by shooting a flare into the sky, initiating a thrilling defense sequence as they await extraction by the Hideout Team.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/fe2fdf31345bf426af68086ba56c236f677afaf0.gif[/img]

In Free-Roam mode, every decision counts. Will you risk it all for precious loot, or play it safe and ensure a successful extraction? The choice is yours, but remember, in the world of Projekt Z: Beyond Order, fortune favors the bold.

[h3]Character Abilities Sneak Peek[/h3]

Since we announced Projekt Z: Beyond Order, we have always talked about the characters and their abilities but never showed them off in one of our Devlogs. This will Change now. In today's development blog, we want to show you two characters, Alina and Gustav, who both play some big roles in the game.


[b]Alina (Medic)[/b]
Alina Burov, a 25-year-old Soviet medic and sniper born in 1917, embodies resilience amidst war. Armed with a Medic Gun and syringes, she takes on the healer role, mending wounds and curing status effects. With her "Medic Scream" ability, she swiftly assesses her team's condition, ensuring seamless coordination. As a sniper, her sharp eye defends her comrades against the zombie horde, reflecting her unwavering dedication to her homeland and comrades.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/ad715b2caf53c0c7e0edb0dd6defe77087984391.jpg[/img]

[u]Medic Gun[/u]
[list]
[*] Alina's main ability is her versatile Medic Gun, which can heal teammates and cure various status effects such as "Break," "Wound," "Burned," and more. This unique tool makes her the perfect healer for the team, ensuring that everyone can stay in the fight longer. The Medic Gun can be used at range, allowing Alina to provide critical support from a safe distance, even in the midst of chaotic battles. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/d464644ef16ed6f5557572dd0139d6d60516b4ca.gif[/img]
[/list]
[u]Self Heal[/u]

[list]
[*] Alina's expertise extends beyond just healing her teammates; she's equipped with medic syringes that allow her to tend to her own wounds to a certain degree. In the heat of battle, when she finds herself in a tight spot, Alina can administer these syringes to patch herself up, granting her the ability to sustain her own health and stay in the fight longer.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/47e1bee41f44e1f205388be4f78bcf732630b8d2.gif[/img]
[/list]
[u]Medic Cry[/u]

[list]
[*] To minimize UI distractions during gameplay, Alina possesses the unique ability called "Medic Scream." With a button press, she can assess the health status and any inflicted conditions of her teammates. This intuitive action eliminates the need for excessive HUD elements, allowing Alina to swiftly gather crucial information about her team's well-being in the heat of battle.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/ad08a42f14182c714c9a14ad97cd7b3b53be13af.gif[/img]
[/list]

[b]Gustav (Tank)[/b]
Gustav Olsson, a 56-year-old WWI veteran and fisherman from Färoër Island, exudes unyielding strength. Born in 1886 in Southern Jutland, he was the youngest of three boys. Despite his solitary life, Gustav's world is disrupted when his close friend arrives with unexpected news. In the game, he assumes the "tank" role, wielding the powerful Stationary Madsen Machine Gun to anchor the squad with suppressive fire and steadfast defense. Gustav's stoic presence and unwavering loyalty make him a formidable ally against the relentless zombie onslaught.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/b299e19a44600c455a2c92a3718fe1693d15fa5e.jpg[/img]

[u]Stationary Madsen Machine Gun[/u]

[list]
[*] Gustav's main ability is the Stationary Madsen Machine Gun. This powerful, belt-fed weapon excels at holding positions and providing sustained fire support, making it perfect for covering your co-op mates. With impressive accuracy and stopping power, it creates a deadly zone of suppression. Its sturdy tripod ensures minimal recoil, allowing Gustav to maintain a steady stream of bullets, making the Madsen an indispensable asset in battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/5ce40b818670d3b6a9dd256aaf642aaa94521aef.gif[/img]
[/list]
[u]Self Heal[/u]

[list]
[*] Gustav's resilience extends beyond his formidable firepower. While manning the Stationary Madsen Machine Gun, he possesses a unique Self-heal ability, allowing him to regenerate health gradually over time. This self-sustaining capability ensures that Gustav can withstand sustained enemy fire while holding down strategic positions for extended periods.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/42349dda66676b9fcf2d1bd389660e15b8d9fe4b.gif[/img]
[/list]
[h3]Conception Of Upcoming Environments[/h3]

Our concept art team maintains a tight collaboration with our level design department to deliver captivating and distinctive environments. Today, we're thrilled to offer you a sneak peek into one of the missions you'll encounter in Projekt Z: Beyond Order, showcasing a glimpse of the captivating work currently underway.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/891c324803b7fae2654f3e3f5172c378f4f4c007.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/cfb43bf7835d98fcfbb86d31c724a127549a03fb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/cd58a6f66ab94550970bfa7534c88a0cee249fa0.png[/img]
[b]Developer Comments:[/b]
[list]
[*] [i]Projekt Z, for me, is a game that clearly deviates from historical events and explores technological what-ifs such as the Nazi's Wunderwaffen, yet is mostly grounded. So, a lot of my work involves researching how they built their machinery and structures back then and applying these ideas to the work of our narrative designers. We often share these references with our amazing colleagues from the 3D Team and go on to discuss matters such as authentic color schemes and methods of construction at the time. Ultimately, we aim to create an experience that is not too removed from reality so that the fictional elements that we do have, such as the Zombies, gain a more gritty and dramatic nature through it.[/i]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/73174ada8a2b38ba7cfe601f6267a47f5660195b.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/2d3172ccfc7a407df2eac8f7dc807ee15b6b9342.jpg[/img][/url]
[i]Stefan Wacker (Lead Concept Artist)[/i]
[/list]
[h3]Unveiling the Latest: Inside Our Newest Devlog - Projekt Z: Beyond Order Update[/h3]
[previewyoutube=yQpMX3ewC0g;full][/previewyoutube]
If you haven't already, be sure to join our Discord server (linked in the description below) to be a part of the development journey. We value your input and often share exclusive work-in-progress content and surveys to gather your early feedback.

Stay tuned for more updates as we continue to fine-tune and polish Projekt Z: Beyond Order into the ultimate coop experience. Until then, stay vigilant, stay alive, and never stop fighting. The fate of humanity rests in your hands.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/763310/Projekt_Z_Beyond_Order

notes.title: Projekt Z: Beyond Order | Blogpost #1
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Survivors![/h2]

We're back with another thrilling update on the development of Projekt Z: Beyond Order. As our team continues to push the boundaries of immersive gameplay, we're excited to share some of the latest enhancements and additions that will elevate your gaming experience to new heights.

[h3]New Weapons: Arm Yourself for the Apocalypse[/h3]
Our diligent Weapon Team is diligently crafting an exciting assortment of firearms for Projekt Z: Beyond Order, including the M1897, Kar98, and M3A1. While some of these weapons are already animated, others are in the final stages of preparation. We're eager for players to wield them in the game!
[list]
[*] [b]M3A1[/b]
The M3 is an American .45-caliber submachine gun adopted by the U.S. Army on December 12, 1942, as the United States Submachine Gun. 
(Source: Wikipedia)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/c6a87df5be6e5966dac47d69f78a10d73d693a14.gif[/img]

[*][b]M1897[/b]
The M1897, also known as the Model 97, M97, Riot Gun, or Trench Gun, is a pump-action shotgun with an external hammer and tube magazine manufactured by the Winchester Repeating Arms Company. (Source: Wikipedia)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/cbb0a4df230a3578434649e33e63c53b21d1830b.jpg[/img]

[*][b]Kar98[/b]
The Karabiner 98 kurz, often abbreviated Karabiner 98k, Kar98k or K98k and also sometimes incorrectly referred to as a K98, is a bolt-action rifle chambered for the 7.92×57mm Mauser cartridge. It was adopted on 21 June 1935 as the standard service rifle by the German Wehrmacht. 
(Source: Wikipedia)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/76ae57b16717510d0a184d8d385ca0d635e955af.png[/img]
[/list]

[h3]Health Items: A Lifeline in the Chaos[/h3]
Projekt Z: Beyond Order introduces a variety of status effects within its Health System, including "Break," "Wound," "Burn," and "Toxic." Each effect impacts players differently, requiring distinct Health items to remedy. While previous devlogs showcased the standard bandage, here's an exclusive glimpse into the other health items awaiting players.

[list]
[*][b]Bandage[/b]
The Bandage is a crucial item found abundantly throughout the game. When used, it restores the player's health points (HP) and eliminates the "Wound" status effect.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/1dae245e34c85f49c146b4da7bfbde91c28e862b.gif[/img]

[*][b]Burn Cream[/b]
The Burn Cream offers a moderate health boost of 15HP and effectively treats the "Burn" status effect upon application.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/65aa8ee9b373634a3308f23e518241a22d6fc2ae.gif[/img]

[*][b]Splint[/b]
Essential for addressing injuries sustained from falls or other high-impact situations, the Splint doesn't restore HP but swiftly resolves the "Break" status effect.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/c31bfcea08a3dd6aaf308a71c233c79110443588.gif[/img]

[*][b]Trauma Pack[/b]
A rare, coveted end-game item, the Trauma Pack holds immense restorative power. It can alleviate any status effect and fully restore the player's health to 100%.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/fc6c2e6bd6b98b89603903bdae00aa52b8dabaa9.gif[/img]

[*][b]Iodin Bottle[/b]
Designed for countering the "Toxic" status effect, typically acquired from exposure to hazardous gases or proximity to radioactive elements or adversaries. The Iodine Bottle exclusively removes this status effect without replenishing HP.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/a915448afff3ca263e51013a1ea1776804c6e4f2.gif[/img]

[/list]

[h3]Enhancing Immersion: Zombies Take the Plunge in Projekt Z: Beyond Order[/h3]
Our dedicated AI team is diligently crafting captivating behaviors for our zombie adversaries. We're thrilled to offer a sneak peek at one of our latest additions: zombies can now dynamically descend from elevated positions, heightening immersion and intensifying the sense of danger. Get ready to experience a more visceral and immersive encounter as you navigate the perilous world of Projekt Z: Beyond Order.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40935273/4fd23878bbb7dd1f83540697d890bd5bcf4b1da2.gif[/img]

[h3]Unveiling the Latest: Inside Our Newest Devlog - Projekt Z: Beyond Order Update[/h3]
[previewyoutube=yQpMX3ewC0g;full][/previewyoutube]
If you haven't already, be sure to join our Discord server (linked in the description below) to be a part of the development journey. We value your input and often share exclusive work-in-progress content and surveys to gather your early feedback.

Stay tuned for more updates as we continue to fine-tune and polish Projekt Z: Beyond Order into the ultimate coop experience. Until then, stay vigilant, stay alive, and never stop fighting. The fate of humanity rests in your hands.
